disk_image.description: Path to the FAT disk image file to mount

mountpoint.description: Directory where the filesystem will be mounted

readonly.description: Mount the filesystem in read-only mode (implies -o ro)

readwrite.description: Mount the filesystem in read-write mode (implies -o rw unless force is present; use rw+ for rw,force shortcut)

force.description: Confirm read-write access (required to enable -o rw mode); used with -o rw or implied by -o rw+
